leadText:
Pecharunt (Japanese: モモワロウ Momowarou), known by the Kitakami people as the Never-Rotting Peach, 
 
Eventually, the old couple requested that Pecharunt acquire a brilliant set of masks, rumored to exist in the land of Kitakami. Having grown tired of the same old requests, Pecharunt was excited to be given a novel task and hurriedly set off to Kitakami with Okidogi. During their travels, the two met a clumsy and dim-witted Pokémon who longed for cleverness, . Using the same method it did with Okidogi, Pecharunt made Munkidori its second retainer. With the toxic chain stimulating its brain, Munkidori's psychic powers bloomed, allowing it to see into the near future. Yet Pecharunt still worried, and so it found a third companion, one that had short, dull feathers who wished for beauty, . The chain not only led it to gain an exquisite appearance and lovely voice, but also gave it the ability to scatter beguiling pheromones that could captivate people and Pokémon. Only then did Pecharunt feel safe, and their journey truly began. 
 vs. ]]
The four traveled through fields, climbed mountains, and crossed seas, before finally reaching their destination. After arriving in Kitakami during the Festival of Masks, Pecharunt and its three retainers spotted and its human partner wearing two of the masks. Erring on caution, Pecharunt had Munkidori track down their home in the Dreaded Den at the top of Oni Mountain, then tasked Okidogi and Fezandipiti with quietly stealing the masks while the two were away. Just as they were about to leave, Ogerpon's partner appeared unexpectedly, and a brawl ensued. However, the man could only muster the strength to protect one of the masks, and the two thieves made off with the remaining three. Pecharunt briefly reveled in its victory when suddenly the enraged Ogerpon confronted them. Panicking, Pecharunt ordered its retainers to fight, using its mochi to empower them; Fezandipiti employed its pheromones, Munkidori used its foresight to predict attacks, and Okidogi attempted to end the battle with its raw might. Yet none could stop Ogerpon's advance and, despite their best efforts, the three were defeated and slain. Unable to defend itself, Pecharunt trembled as Ogerpon launched a final strike against it. Using the last of its strength, Pecharunt managed to clasp its shell closed and rolled away deep into the forest, falling into a deep slumber.

==== ====
=====The Teal Mask=====
The slumbering form of Pecharunt is first seen on the counter of Peachy's in Mossui Town. After completing the story of The Indigo Disk, the can obtain a Mythical Pecha Berry, the same kind that Pecharunt used to deliver to its adoptive parents hundreds of years ago, and bring it to Peachy's, causing Pecharunt to awaken. It vanishes along with the Mythical Pecha Berry when the player's back turns away following a phone call from Arven to inform the player about his arrival at their house.

Perhaps still resolved to grant the old couple's request, and oblivious to how much time had passed as it was asleep, Pecharunt produced more of its Binding Mochi and left them on a plate at the counter of Peachy's for anyone to eat. As time passed, more and more of the townsfolk (including Carmine) eat the mochi and end up falling under Pecharunt's control, leading to rumors being spread about a curse going around Mossui Town. 

=====Mochi Mayhem=====
 defending Pecharunt]]
Penny told the player, Kieran, and Arven that she was startled by something "round and weird". Meanwhile, Pecharunt floated inside its shell above the store. It then opened up and fired several pieces of Binding Mochi at them, aiming directly at their mouths, though it missed Kieran and the player. A battle ensued between the possessed Arven and Penny against Kieran and the player. Upon the possessed duo's defeat, Pecharunt attempted to sneak away and hastily fled towards Loyalty Plaza as Kieran and the player pursued.

As the player and Kieran reached Loyalty Plaza, the two spotted Nemona, who had also been possessed, with Pecharunt floating near her soon after and briefly taunting them. The effects of the Binding Mochi were unable to control Nemona's obsession with Pokémon battles, thus leading to a battle between her and the player. At the same time, Pecharunt directed what appeared to be the rest of the possessed town to Loyalty Plaza, forcing Kieran to stay back and hold them off while the player battled Nemona. Shocked at the loss of the strongest Trainer under its influence, Pecharunt battled the player itself in a last ditch effort to stop them, though it was ultimately defeated and caught. Afterwards, the possessed humans under Pecharunt's control were returned to normal as the Binding Mochi's effect disappeared. 

Some time later, back at Blueberry Academy and based on a hunch of hers, Carmine correctly assumed that Pecharunt had something to do with the Loyal Three. Regardless, she concluded that, since they cannot ask the Pokémon directly, it'll likely remain a mystery.
 

===Personality and characteristics===
 
 
Pecharunt is a childish Pokémon with a young mind. It will use its power to gain as much attention and love as possible from friends and family. Pecharunt enjoys granting others' wishes and requests in order to receive the affection it craves in return. However, this also makes it a greedy and spoiled Pokémon, determined to have what it wants no matter the cost, even "cursing" its caretakers so they love it even more. Timid and cowardly by nature, Pecharunt tends to flee or cower in fear should its allies be defeated. 

Despite these deceptive traits, Pecharunt shows a deep attachment for its retainers and family. It reacts negatively when any of the Loyal Three are used in battle against it, perhaps angered or shocked by their apparent betrayal. It's still a good Pokémon at heart, viewing the ones it brainwashes as its friends, as seen with the Loyal Three. Pecharunt acts mostly out of fear and loneliness, as it is not capable of defending itself very well.
 

===In battle===
 

==In the spin-off games==
 event]]
=== ===
 

Pecharunt appears in the Pecharunt Strikes Back story event. It appeared in Pasio to brainwash people until it was stopped by , who then offers it to join her, forming a sync pair with her, which it accepts. Carmine referred to it as the same Pecharunt that brainwashed her in Kitakami. 

 
 

 

==Trivia==
At the end of the Mochi Mayhem epilogue, Pecharunt can be caught at level 88. This is part of the theme it and the Loyal Three possess with the number 8.
Before the official reveal of , several hints of its existence and relation to both and the Loyal Three were left in Scarlet and Violet's The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero expansion:
It briefly appeared with its shell closed in Ogerpon's story told by Yukito in The Teal Mask storyline. 
What appears to be a Pecharunt decoration can also be seen at Peachy's in Mossui Town, which is later revealed in Mochi Mayhem to be Pecharunt itself.
